items.headline: Chad Ryland kicks winning FG after PAT miss that forced OT as Cards get wild 33-30 win over Cowboys
items.description: — Chad Ryland kicked a winning 42-yard field goal in overtime after missing a PAT that would have won the game with 6 seconds left in regulation, and the Arizona Cardinals rallied for a wild 33-30 victory over the Dallas Cowboys on Sunday.
